title: Own the M3 PR application boundary implementation paths
goal: Provide unique exact path ownership for M3 contracts Host behavior Companion Workbench and tests in the PR root plan-set.
acceptanceCriteria: The typed application service exposes only the four catalogued setup protection authorities and lifecycle operations.
Protection status is non-vacuous and fails closed unless every required local and CI authority component passes.
Profile Plan Module and lifecycle handoffs preserve exact identifiers and hashes while unavailable actions stay explicit.
The loopback Companion requires a session exact origin independent CSRF bounded bodies current previews and cancellable serialized execution.
Confirmation re-runs the Host preview and emits an applied-false receipt with every unperformed authority boundary.
Focused and affected regression suites pass without changing the frozen stable CLI compatibility baseline.
risks: A stale preview could be confirmed after its Package or Target inputs change.
A loopback caller could attempt cross-origin or oversized requests against the Companion.
Empty or partial evidence could be presented as protected.
A lifecycle preview could be mistaken for authorization to mutate Target or remote state.
decisions: Keep the M3 application command surface experimental and separate from the frozen stable CLI contract.
Bind previews to catalogued schemas exact Package Target State Evidence and Plan identities and the current preview hash.
Require session exact loopback origin independent CSRF request limits serialization and cancellation in the Companion.
Expose only lifecycle verification while compose select rollback retention and remote activation remain unavailable.
